name: @tradrl/body-execution
description: Execution body contracts (Work Order T025, the order-life-cycle specialist): EXECUTION_BODY — the order-lifecycle body spec (agent-body BodyVersion structural mirror + execution declaration: mission, capabilities, knowledge/tool policy, procedures, delegation, L8 authority scope in the external-gateway-only REQUEST mode — the body REQUESTS through the gateway, the gateway executes; invariant 6, L8/L20 — with the L16 strategic/execution separation: the order-level clock, distinct from any strategic asOf); the DECLARED total order-state machine — nine states (prepared, submitted, acknowledged, partially_filled, filled, cancelled, rejected, expired, stuck) with typed, enumerable transitions (an undefined transition is the typed lifecycle_violation; every record carries decision ref, order refs, the L16 clock marker, tenant/project, exact-decimal quantities — float mediation is the typed decimal_imprecision; a lifecycle record stamped with strategic time is the typed clock_confusion); the DECLARED-METHOD order-management discipline (versioned order-preparation, stuck-order-detection, fill-reconciliation, cancellation-policy and kill-switch-response method records — an order-management procedure without a declared, versioned method is a typed error); the order-lane intake mirrors (T019's ApproveDecision/RefusalDecision, the order intent, SimulatedFill, the kill-switch standing state, T020's limit states — plus the T024 director directive as OPAQUE refs; never imported, D-003/D-004); and the declared monitoring procedures — stuck-order escalation (an EscalationRecord, never an exception, never a silent timeout), exact-equality fill reconciliation (one smallest-grid-step mismatch is the typed reconciliation_gap), the cancellation policy with race recording, and kill-switch mid-flight response (escalate and record, NEVER fabricate a fill or a cancel) — all with derived digest identities, chain-verified append-only logs and byte-deterministic canonical serialization.
